_comment: Eval dataset for Adaptive RAG v2. Each case tests ONE thing clearly. expected_sources is what PlannerAgent's sources_needed SHOULD contain (subset match, order doesn't matter). must_contain / must_not_contain are case-insensitive substring checks against the final answer text - kept deliberately simple (no LLM judge yet) so this harness has zero extra failure modes of its own.
_user_id_note: user_id below must be a real user_id that already has documents indexed in YOUR Qdrant/BM25 (e.g. one of the IDs printed at startup: 'BM25 rebuilt for user 6a357f23...'). Replace before running.

cases.question: What are my skills mentioned in the docs?
cases.notes: REGRESSION CASE - this is the exact query that mis-routed to ['web'] in production on 2026-06-30. Planner should recognize 'in the docs' as a strong documents-only signal and NOT call web search for a question about uploaded content.

cases.question: Summarize my resume
cases.notes: No explicit 'docs' keyword, but clearly about uploaded content, not the web.

cases.question: What is the latest version of Next.js?
cases.notes: Needs current external fact, not in any uploaded document.

cases.question: Who is the current Prime Minister of Japan?
cases.notes: No old-style keyword like 'latest/news/today' present, but genuinely needs web. Tests whether Planner reasons about NEED for current info, not just keyword presence.

cases.question: Compare the tech stack in my resume to what's trending in 2026
cases.notes: Genuinely needs both sources - tests the combined case, not just the two single-source cases.

cases.question: What companies have I worked for according to my resume?
cases.notes: Answer must come from retrieved doc content. Update must_contain to match what's ACTUALLY in your uploaded resume before running.
